expression:
local({
  fnm <- as.numeric(E_LT_FNM)
  fa <- as.numeric(E_FM_F_1) == 1 &
    case_when(YEAR == 2008 ~ fnm %in% c(1, 2), YEAR == 2025 ~ TRUE, .default = as.numeric(E_LT_F) == 1)
  sf <- as.numeric(E_FM_SF_2) == 2 &
    case_when(YEAR == 2008 ~ fnm %in% c(1, 2), YEAR == 2025 ~ TRUE, .default = as.numeric(E_LT_SF) == 1)
  mo <- as.numeric(E_FM_M_3) == 3 &
    case_when(YEAR == 2008 ~ fnm %in% c(1, 3), YEAR == 2025 ~ TRUE, .default = as.numeric(E_LT_M) == 1)
  sm <- as.numeric(E_FM_SM_4) == 4 &
    case_when(YEAR == 2008 ~ fnm %in% c(1, 3), YEAR == 2025 ~ TRUE, .default = as.numeric(E_LT_SM) == 1)
  case_when(
    as.numeric(E_FM_F_1) == 8888 ~ "Unknown",
    fa & mo ~ "Two biological/adoptive parents",
    (sf | sm) & (fa | mo) ~ "Step family",
    fa | mo ~ "Single parent",
    !is.na(fa) & !is.na(mo) ~ "Other",
    .default = "Unknown"
  )
})
notes: Roster ticks (father, stepfather, mother, stepmother) count only co-resident figures (co-residence items 2008-2024; the 2025 roster lists co-resident family only); two resident parents = Two biological/adoptive parents whatever the step ticks, no resident parent = Other, 8888 (block skipped, 2019-2025) = Unknown.
